rules:
Second-backbone replication, decided per backbone (smol, qwen25vl3b).
Cells: {Q1_top_0-30, Q2_top_480-510} x {speed, path} = 4. A cell is DEGENERATE if the arm in
question has <= 2 distinct parsed answers; degenerate cells never count toward a verdict, and if
fewer than 3 of 4 cells are non-degenerate the verdict is LIMITED.

R1 dissociation replicates (metre-only adapter, explicit arms): in >= 3 of 4 non-degenerate cells,
   metre Spearman rho >= 0.30 AND paired cm/m ratio R <= 3.  Fails if >= 3 cells have R >= 10.
R2 M1 replicates (mixed-unit adapter): R >= 10 in >= 3 of 4 non-degenerate cells, reported
   separately for explicit (E) and in-template (T) arms.  Fails if >= 3 cells have R <= 3.
R3 arithmetic: on the 246 diagnostic items, the metre-only adapter is below the bare backbone
   (exact McNemar p < 0.01), and the mixed-unit adapter is not (p >= 0.01 or above the backbone).
R4 temporal: first-frame repetition lowers metre rho in >= 3 of 4 defined cells for the
   metre-only adapter.
Anything else is reported as intermediate.  A failed replication is reported as failed and the
paper's claims are scoped to the backbone(s) on which they hold.
